newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finland plans tougher child porn punishment.
newsitem.headline: Finland plans tougher child porn punishment.

text.p: Finland's justice minister pledged tougher punishment on Thursday for child pornography offenders in a broad review of a law which dates back to 1927.
So far distributing child pornography has been considered a minor offence and ownership is not a crime.

Pledging legal reforms soon, Kari Hakamies said in a speech to a seminar: "The aim is to make the possession of child pornography a punishable offence and to significantly stiffen the punishment for distribution of pictures that offend sexual decency."

Child welfare groups have been pushing for possession of child pornography to be made a crime. Two months ago, Finnish police said they had no power to arrest a suspect found hoarding a massive computer library of "exceptionally severe" material.
The government also plans a ruling allowing the authorities, not just the victims, to bring charges of rape, incest and the sexual abuse of children, Hakamies said.
